1) 在 vCenter 上定位该 ESXi 主机，看是哪些虚拟机贡献了主要负载: 1) Locate the ESXi host in vCenter and see which virtual machines contribute most of the load; 2) Use vSphere DRS or a manual vMotion to move some VMs to a less loaded host; 3) Confirm no VM is squeezing the others through over-provisioned vCPUs; 4) If the whole cluster is running hot, add physical hosts.
1) 在 vCenter 定位该 Datastore，按容量排序找出占用最大的虚: 1) Locate the datastore in vCenter and sort by capacity to find the largest VMs and snapshots; 2) Clean up leftover snapshots first — snapshots are the most common reason a datastore fills up; 3) Remove unused ISOs, templates and leftover files from decommissioned VMs; 4) Use Storage vMotion to move some VMs to a datastore with headroom, and expand capacity longer term.
1) 登录该虚拟机内部，定位占用最高的进程并判断是否内存泄漏；2) 在 vCen: 1) Log in to the VM and find the largest memory consumer, judging whether it is a leak; 2) In vCenter check the VM's Balloon and Swapped metrics — non-zero means the host is reclaiming its memory; 3) If the host is tight, migrate VMs or expand the host first; 4) If the VM itself is short, add memory; if it is a leak, locate it in the application.
1) 登录该虚拟机内部，用 top/任务管理器定位占用最高的进程；2) 区分业务: 1) Log in to the VM and use top or Task Manager to find the busiest process; 2) Tell traffic growth apart from a program fault (infinite loop, frequent GC); 3) Check the VM's CPU Ready value in vCenter — high means host contention rather than the VM being undersized; 4) Add vCPUs once confirmed, or migrate the VM to a less loaded host.
ESXi 宿主机 CPU 使用率超过 70%，其上所有虚拟机都会开始出现 CPU: ESXi host CPU utilization is above 70%; every VM on it will start seeing CPU Ready wait and slower responses.
ESXi 宿主机内存使用率超过 70%，继续上升会触发内存气球回收、压缩甚至交换: ESXi host memory utilization is above 70%; further growth triggers ballooning, compression and eventually swapping, and VM performance will degrade significantly.
vSphere 数据存储（Datastore）使用率超过 70%。数据存储写满会: vSphere datastore utilization is above 70%. A full datastore instantly suspends virtual machines, and thin-provisioned disks are hit first.
虚拟机 CPU 使用率超过 70%，应用响应会开始变慢。: Virtual machine CPU utilization is above 70% and application responses will start to slow.
虚拟机内存使用率超过 70%，继续增长会触发 guest 内的换页，应用响应变慢: Virtual machine memory utilization is above 70%; further growth triggers paging inside the guest and slows applications down.
